GOV-F-004-S68.title: Audit Log Schema and Append-Only Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S68.description: Define the audit log data model including fields for timestamp, actor (GPT/Claude/system), operation type, input/output metadata, trace_id, parent_trace_id, and immutability constraints. Enforce append-only semantics at schema and repository level.
GOV-F-004-S68.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (existing audit logging); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py; RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S69.title: Core Append-Only Audit Logging Service
GOV-F-004-S69.description: Implement centralized audit logging service responsible for writing immutable records, generating trace IDs, enforcing no-update/no-delete behavior, and handling high-throughput writes safely.

GOV-F-004-S70.title: Audit Log Retrieval API for Internal Use
GOV-F-004-S70.description: Expose secure internal API endpoints to query audit logs by trace_id, time range, or actor for debugging, QA, and compliance verification. Ensure read-only access with no mutation capability.
GOV-F-004-S70.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (FastAPI patterns); Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (read-only access patterns); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S71.title: Audit Logging Test Suite and Immutability Validation
GOV-F-004-S71.description: Create unit and integration tests validating append-only behavior, ensuring no updates/deletes are possible, verifying trace chaining, and confirming logs are written for all critical operations.

GOV-F-004-S67.title: Audit Logging Integration Across GPT, Claude, and Pipeline Entry Points
GOV-F-004-S67.description: Integrate the append-only audit logging service into all execution entry points including FastAPI main loop, tool_router, Brain runner, GPTReader, and safety_service. Ensure every model action, tool invocation, and external API call produces a compliant audit record with trace continuity.

GOV-F-004.mitigation: Leverage existing debug_logger patterns and enforce append-only via application-layer guards without introducing new infrastructure
